description: Defines classes and methods for managing UE (User Equipment) slices and repositories within a RAN (Radio Access Network) slice context, including candidate UE management for scheduling.

classes.name: slice_ue
classes.description: Represents a UE candidate for scheduling within a specific RAN slice, providing access to UE metrics and logical channel info.

classes.name: slice_ue_repository
classes.description: Container managing all UEs belonging to a specific RAN slice, supporting addition, removal, and querying of UEs and their bearers.

methods.name: slice_ue::slice_ue
methods.description: Constructor initializing a slice_ue object with references to UE, UE carrier context, and slice ID.

methods.name: slice_ue::ue_index
methods.description: Returns the DU UE index.

methods.name: slice_ue::crnti
methods.description: Returns the UE's C-RNTI.

methods.name: slice_ue::ran_slice_id
methods.description: Returns the RAN slice ID.

methods.name: slice_ue::get_cc
methods.description: Fetches the UE carrier context managed by this slice.

methods.name: slice_ue::get_lcg_id
methods.description: Fetches the logical channel group associated with a given LCID.

methods.name: slice_ue::contains
methods.description: Checks if a given LCID or LCG ID is part of this slice.

methods.name: slice_ue::has_pending_dl_newtx_bytes
methods.description: Checks if there are DL pending bytes yet to be allocated in DL HARQ.

methods.name: slice_ue::pending_dl_newtx_bytes
methods.description: Computes the number of DL pending bytes for the slice.

methods.name: slice_ue::pending_dl_newtx_bytes(lcid_t)
methods.description: Computes DL pending bytes for a specific LCID.

methods.name: slice_ue::pending_ul_newtx_bytes
methods.description: Computes UL pending bytes in bearers belonging to this slice.

methods.name: slice_ue::pending_ul_unacked_bytes
methods.description: Computes UL bytes yet to be received by the scheduler for a given LCG.

methods.name: slice_ue::has_pending_sr
methods.description: Returns whether a SR indication handling is pending.

methods.name: slice_ue::logical_channels
methods.description: Retrieves QoS info of DRBs configured for the UE.

methods.name: slice_ue::dl_avg_bit_rate
methods.description: Returns average DL bit rate for a logical channel.

methods.name: slice_ue::ul_avg_bit_rate
methods.description: Returns average UL bit rate for a logical channel group.

methods.name: slice_ue::dl_hol_toa
methods.description: Retrieves HOL TOA for a logical channel.

methods.name: slice_ue_repository::slice_ue_repository
methods.description: Constructor initializing the repository with slice ID, cell index, and UE repository.

methods.name: slice_ue_repository::empty
methods.description: Checks if the repository has no UEs.

methods.name: slice_ue_repository::size
methods.description: Returns the number of UEs managed.

methods.name: slice_ue_repository::contains
methods.description: Checks if a UE or (UE, LCID) tuple is managed.

methods.name: slice_ue_repository::operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a slice_ue by UE index.

methods.name: slice_ue_repository::add_logical_channel
methods.description: Adds a new UE and logical channel to the repository.

methods.name: slice_ue_repository::rem_logical_channel
methods.description: Removes a (UE, LCID) from the repository.

methods.name: slice_ue_repository::rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the repository.

methods.name: slice_ue_repository::get_ues_with_pending_newtx_data
methods.description: Retrieves UEs with pending data for the slice.
